notes.title: Fisherman, Map Expansion, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922073/97dd0f80ac601226e01c7d5e67e5d374f0507659.jpg[/img]
Happy October! Our team has been very busy lately, but we're here with another Farmtale Update! Thanks to everyone who has been active in the Steam forums, social media, and Discord server!

[h3]New Fisherman![/h3]
With new fishermans hut, you can catch fish and sell them for profit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922073/43192b884deb6a52cc282b24826207cb10cf42d5.png[/img]
// Introduces Fishmerman Hut, Fisherman, and 3 types of fish.
// Fish no longer drop random items

[h3]Map Expansion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922073/04da48da663a2049fbadb54a2e04d6d30bcdeca5.png[/img]
Expand your map and have more room to work with!

[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
//Fixes a bug causes crops to dissappear when restarting the game
//Fixes build navigation initialization (edited)
//Further GPU optimization

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
In light of the new fisherman, we've tweaked the economy and limits of certain buildings and farmers:
-1 farmer hut
-1 fisherman hut
-1 barn
-1 crop hut
-4 houses
-12 farmers
-8 crop farmers
-12 villagers
-6 fisherman

[h3]System Reworks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36922073/089fc04bc8b4d41d7452646a9f15c56f1aa3258e.png[/img]
We felt as though players did not have enough sinks to spill their coins in to. To remedy this, we've added wages that you use to pay farmers to do your dirty work! If there is no money deposited, your workers will not work. Be sure to keep them paid!

You can now withdrawl profits from your farmer markets

notes.title: New Farmer Joins Farmtale!
notes.notes:
Once again, thanks to everyone being active in the Steam forums, social media, and Discord server. You are helping us greatly with the improvement of Farmtale.

[h3]New Farmer![/h3]
We have finally added the much-needed farmer in Farmtale! You can now automate crop farms by building the Crop House. The farmer will water the crops for you as well as harvest them whenever they fully grow. No more finger pain from clicking!

[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
- Greatly optimizes the game including GPU optimization.

- Animal products will now drop in path-able areas which will prevent farmers from getting stuck and doing nothing.

- These buildings will now ramp up in price for each time they are built: Scrap Collector, Farmer Hut and Crop House

- Players would have memory crashes and issues. This is hopefully fixed. No recent reports of this.

- Boosts are now counting in the Steam Achievements.

- The camera is now panning correctly in the 1440p resolution.

- Items in the marketplace would disappear if the marketplace is picked up.

- Non-repurchasable items would be lost forever if recycled or sold.

- The Daily Chest will now close after being opened (visual bug)

- There was an invisible tooltip making sounds when hovered with the mouse cursor.

- Visual improvements including the light sources at night-time.

- The inventory has now a scroll bar just in case you have a lot of items in your inventory.

- Q and E will now rotate the camera.

- R and F will now zoom in and out the camera (the + and - key will also be added tomorrow)

- Portuguese language is now working

notes.title: Farmtale v. 2.0.1 - Music Pack, Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
We have added further improvements to Farmtale, both Quality of Life improvements as well as bug fixes. Thanks a lot for reporting any bugs that you may come by. Or any frustrating gameplay mechanic you want to see improved. We will do our best to make this game better day by day.

[h3]The standalone downloadable music pack content is now available on the Farmtale Store page! Enjoy the music from our amazing composer ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Farmers could get stuck in the ocean water. The building radius is reduced slightly to not spawn farmers in the water.

- Farmers could be "confused" and stand there doing nothing for no reason.

- Sometimes the reassigning of farmers did not work.

- Sometimes you would get a message saying "Can't build because it's blocking the path" even though that was not the case.

- You could pick up a building while building in progress

- Animals would sometimes be invisible when reaching level 3 feed level.

- All translations have been fixed (with possibly one or two words still missing)

- Fixed the memory crash issue when using the Experience Boost and Speed Boost. These are again enabled in the game.

- The Cosmetics Ship and Santa would for some reason not appear anymore in the mid-game. They have found their way back to the island again.

- Quest tracking has been optimized and will disable tracking when completed to decrease lag for the overall game. The game will run slightly faster.

- Removed lag when collecting Material, both from trees and from the Scrap Collectors.



[b][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][/b]
- The game camera can now be rotated using the + and - button.

- You can now use Q and E to zoom in and out

- Completed quests will now appear at the top of the quest list and disappear to the bottom when you claim the reward.

- Added an arrow above the building in "Building Mode" to show you what is the front of the building for a better user experience.

- You can now change between the tools in the toolbar using the 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 keys on your keyboard.

- Added a "Sell all items in category" in the top part of your inventory. Pressing the button will make it possible for you to sell all items in that category instead of one by one. This is especially useful for the animal products.



[h3]Things that are maybe fixed[/h3]
- You would get a memory crash when planting a large crop farm. This has to yet be tested as it might have been fixed when fixing the Boosts and the quest tracking optimization.

- The information pop-up to the bottom left would "flash" for one second and disappear.



[h3]Planned to-do list[/h3]
- Add an option to feed the animals through the Wardrobe view.

- Make the farmers water the crops for you.

- Display all achievements even when they are not completed.

- Make the tutorial more in-depth

- Add the ability to change mouse sensitivity

- Add the ability to use a default mouse cursor

- Add Tower Defense event.

notes.title: Farmtale v. 2.0.0 - Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Thanks to everyone in this community for reporting bugs and suggesting a lot of good improvements. You've been very helpful! We have fixed most of the reported bugs and added quality of life improvements to make the gameplay more enjoyable.[/b]

- You can't build on the waterfall rocks anymore.

- You can't build in the ocean anymore.

- The Cosmetic Ship now appears less frequently.

- Removed vine 2D art from the inventory decoration that was blocking the categories.

- Scrap Material value clamped to not get negative value which would bug the game.

- Scrap collectors set to max 12.

- Scrap collector gain amount reduced to about 45%.

- Santa doesn't get stuck on crops anymore.

- Rain would only water crops the first time it rained. Now it works properly. The crops will always get watered when raining.

- You could place Speed & Experience boosts on the map like normal items which was not intended.

- Farmers are now less annoying when you are moving the farm and trying to place it.

- Some of the tree stumps could not be shoveled until you relogged.

- Farmers can now be assigned to work on a specific animal farm instead of closest. This is done by using the Right Mouse Button on the farmer.

- Sometimes scrap collectors could bug and get invisible.

- 2 of the quests were not working.

- 2 of the quests were not saving.

- The items & buildings you place now check if they can be placed before placing them so you don't get a random error.

- When you sell a house or farmer hut, the farmer/villager will now despawn with it.

- Silos increasing drop speed is working again.

- All Steam achievements and counters have been fixed and loads properly.

- Collision on crops increased so it's easier to plant crops. It's less precise.

- Fish doesn't drop things underwater.

- Wood chopping at the beach won't drop the wood under the sand.

- Visual bug with plants showing 4 levels (through icons) is now reduced to 3 levels as intended.

- Great optimization for inventory updates (fixes inventory cards flashing).

- Inventory items were frustrating to drag out. Drag out would be cancelled randomly sometimes.

- Farmers now prioritizes to loot the animal products if there are more than 10 of them on the ground. This will avoid too many items on the ground, lag and crashes.

- The hitbox for feeding animals is slightly increased so feeding animals is less frustrating.

- You can now drop the food on an animal and choose how much you want to feed it. Previously you had to drag the food one by one onto the animal.

- You can now pick up everything and sell it from the inventory by using Right Mouse Button. Shops and farms can't be picked up.

- Fixes inventory to not be click-through and accidentally opening buildings like the barn.

- The Speed & Experience boost timers would show "1 minute" again when it exceeded 60 minutes.

- The used Speed & Experience boosts would disappear and be lost when logging out. They now save properly.

- The Scrap Material amount would display 0 when relogging and correct itself when you gain Scrap Material. Now it shows the correct amount on relogging.

- The camera could get stuck when moving it behind the waterfall rocks.

- The Cosmetic shop would display wrong items that are not present in the shop.

- Assigning farmers to different farms will now save when you quit and rejoin the game.

- You can now have 4 farmers per farmer hut if you upgrade their limit. This will make it so you don't have to build 8+ huts. 2 huts will be sufficient with full upgrades.

- You can now have 4 villagers per house if you upgrade their limit. This way you don't have to build many houses which takes a lot of space.

- You can't use the shovel tool anymore at the loot box area.

- Fixed an exploit where you could sell an item and still place it in your farm.

- The game will give you the Experience gained when your game is minimized and prevent memory crashes.

- Added an experience display on the animal feeding XP bar.

notes.title: Farmtale Re-designed
notes.notes:
First and foremost, thanks a lot to everyone for your great patience. This update has taken time to release as we re-designed the whole core of Farmtale. This is basically a "Farmtale 2" at this point. This was a necessary step we had to take in order to direct the game towards the better as it lacked content previously.

[i]Thanks to our community for all the constructive feedback and bug reports! These are very much appreciated.[/i]

[h2]Environment[/h2]

[b]Sandbox Building System[/b]
After playing the released version of Farmtale, we thought it will be more fun and unique if the player starts with only the farm area without any buildings or animal farms. From here, the player must design his/her own farm and form a personal adventure. Now you can freely build and decorate your farm from nothing! Remember to post a screenshot of what you've created :-)

[b]Free Camera Rotation[/b]
You now have the freedom to move your camera and to different directions by using the [R] button or clicking CTRL + middle mouse button. This makes Farmtale feel like a new game! The main idea is that Farmtale will be a game without many restrictions.

[b]Day & Night System[/b]
We added a day and night system to Farmtale. You can purchase lighting from the shop to keep your farm bright.

[b]New Level Design[/b]
We re-designed the whole level in Farmtale. We made it look more like a natural environment and you are able to unlock tools that will help you expand your building space. There is plenty of room for your farm decoration.

[b]New Models & Textures[/b]
All the models in Farmtale have been re-modelled and re-textured. We wanted a more elevated look in the game, so we moved away from the completely flat modeling and texturing style. With that said, we've also added a lot of new models to the shop. You can freely place every item wherever you want.

[b]New Material Generator Building[/b]
The forge and lumber mill has been replaced by the Scrap Collector building. The building will automatically generate Material without a farmer and you can build multiple of them! And you don't even need additional pylons.

[h2]Animal Farms[/h2]

[b]Experience System[/b]
Instead of making the experience bars purchasable through Coins and Material, we have added an experience system. Experience bars can no longer be purchased but you can earn experience as the collectable items drop from the animals. Just like an RPG game.

[b]Max Level Change[/b]
Max level has been changed from 100 to 50. The currency values and experience has been changed accordingly. It felt too much with 100 levels right from the beginning. We plan on extending the late-game levels with late-game content but this is still to be decided.

[b]Backpack System[/b]
The items you collect or purchase from the shops will be added into your backpack. You can sell the items by right-click or by dragging them into the new Marketplace. Or refine them into material through the new refine building we added.

[b]Cooldown System[/b]
When an animal drops an item, there will be a cooldown before the animal can begin dropping a new item. The drop times have been lowered too.

[b]Purchasable Animals[/b]
Animals will no longer spawn automatically through leveling. They can be purchased through the new Barn building we added.

[b]Farm Stats[/b]
Many from our community wished to see stats for their animal farms and this is now added to the game. For each farm, you can view how much experience an item gives, the drop speed and more.

[h2]Shops & Menus[/h2]

[b]Re-designed Coin Shop[/b]
The coin shop has been re-designed and all items are viewed through an animated 3D view. All items purchased from the Coin Shop will be added to your backpack. From there, you can drag the item out and place it anywhere you want in your farm.

[b]Build Menu[/b]
Instead of buttons around the environment, you can purchase buildings such as animal farms through the build menu. The chosen buildings can freely be placed around the farm. The timers for building your animal farms has been lowered drastically (from hours to a maximum of 5 minutes).

[b]New Upgrade Menu[/b]
The previous upgrade system we had felt outdated and simply annoying. Therefore we have designed the upgrades as cards. This means that you'll no longer see hundreds of upgrades in your upgrade window. Only a few upgradable cards!
We have added new upgrades to the menu. This includes Experience upgrades, Cooldown upgrades and more.

[b]Skin Shop[/b]
You can now buy skins for coins to your animals! Going into the wardrobe, you can give your animals clothes, hats and several items.

[b]Crops[/b]
You can now plant crops and harvest them to either sell them or feed your animals for more rewards.

[h2]Farmers[/h2]

[b]Free Movement[/b]
Farmers are now universal and not attached to a specific farm. This means they freely roam outside of the animal farms.

[b]Farmer Limit[/b]
With the new farmer system, there is no limit for how many farmers you have. For every Farmer Hut you build, you will get a farmer.

[b]Farmer Upgrades[/b]
The farmer upgrades have been removed and their base stats have been increased.

[h2]Questing[/h2]

[b]Questing System[/b]
We have added quests to Farmtale. Complete quests and receive rewards for it to help you progress through Farmtale. The final quests will give you something special. A quest tracker will definitely be a good thing to add in the future update.

[h2]Sound[/h2]

[b]New Soundtrack[/b]
We've added multiple new soundtracks to Farmtale. The current style is now more chill and relaxing.

[b]Upgraded Sound Effects[/b]
All the sound effects has been revised and upgraded into something more fitting.

[h2]VFX, Animation & User Interface[/h2]

[b]New Visual Effects[/b]
All of the visual effects has been updated to fit the new style of the game.

[b]New & Upgraded UI Elements[/b]
We have added a lot of new UI elements as we've added more features into the game. We have also updated already-made UI into something more advanced.

[b]ESC Button[/b]
In the current version, when clicking on the ESC button on your keyboard, it would bring up the ESC Menu. This didn't seem optimal when you already had shop windows open. The ESC button will now close windows before bringing up the Quit menu. 

[b]Reset Button[/b]
You can choose to reset your progress if you wish. We have added a reset game button in the settings menu.

[b]New Animations[/b]
We've added a few new animations to keep up with the current version of Farmtale.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]

[b]New & Updates Achievements[/b]
We got a lot of feedback about the achievements being too difficult. And we agree. We have deleted a lot of achievements and reduced the amount. We felt it we had too many achievements popping up and it felt less rewarding if they appeared frequently. We have also made the achievements less difficult so you don't have to collect insane amounts of items and currencies.

[h2]Languages[/h2]

[b]New language added[/b]
Brazilian Portuguese has been added as a new language to the game.

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[b]Better performance[/b]
We know that the current game has performance issues and it's putting too much work on the CPU and graphics card. We have re-done all code and kept optimization in mind when designing the new 3D models and programming. We have reduced the usage drastically and it is now at a good performance level. You can now play the game in full quality without adding much work on your hardware.

[b][i]Thanks again for all of your support. Please find us on any Social Media @TitanforgedEnt and give us your feedback on the game! Or simply have a nice chat with us. We will see you there![/i][/b]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Bug fixes and Refinements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First and foremost thanks a lot for your amazing support. We really appreciate every bit of it. This update contains all the bug fixes and refinements taken place after the release of Farmtale. At the very end you can read more about future plans and what features we want to implement.

[h2]Bug Fixes Since Release[/h2]

[b]Frequent game crashes:[/b] [i]A game crash would occur with "Fatal Error!" a couple of times every hour. This was the most frustrating bug to deal with because the crash logs didn't give us clues to what was wrong. Luckily our programmer found the issue 2 days after the launch date.[/i]

[b]Not gaining Material while being offline:[/b] [i]The offline display would tell you how much Material you received while being offline, but that amount was not added to your Material counter.[/i]

[b]Steam achievements not working properly:[/b] [i]The achievements were not linked correctly to the events in the game and the counter was not working as intended.[/i]

[b]Stopped receiving mails upon relog:[/b] [i]When logging off and in for the first time, the player would not receive mails from the mailbox anymore.[/i]

[b]Mailbox giving 12 coins sometimes:[/b] [i]The mailbox would sometimes give 12 coins during the game which was only supposed to happen during the tutorial.[/i]

[b]The pirate ship timer showing -01:[/b] [i]When building the pirate ship, the timer would show -01 and would instantly build the pirate ship upon relog.[/i]

[b]The pirate ship timer not counting down when being offline:[/b] [i]Since the pirate ship build timer is long, it was important that the pirate ship counter still counted down when the player went offline.[/i]

[b]Pigs and farmer getting stuck:[/b] [i]The pig and the farmer would sometimes get stuck in the large plate item bought from the coin shop.[/i]

[b]Scraps not being clickable sometimes:[/b] [i]The scraps would sometimes get stuck beneath invisible items and therefore not being lootable anymore.[/i]

[b]Water looking white in low resolution:[/b] [i]The water shader would be completely white when playing with medium or low texture resolution.[/i]

[b]Danish language displayed wrong offline earnings:[/b] [i]When selecting the Danish language, the offline earnings would display wrong static numbers for how much Coins and Material were earned while being offline.[/i]

[b]We are still missing a bug where an animal will disappear all of a sudden during gameplay but reappear when the player relogs. If you have this bug, please send us a screenshot of your farm and maybe on how your animal disappeared if you observed anything. We want to reproduce the bug. ːsteamfacepalmː[/b]

[h2]Refinements Since Release[/h2]

[b]Chicken Farm income reduced:[/b] [i]The Chicken Farm was very strong from level 1 till level 100. This made every other farm feel pointless and therefore the income was reduced towards a more balanced gameplay.[/i]

[b]Duck Farm income increased:[/b] [i]The Duck Farm didn't give enough coins for the cost value and therefore we gave the income a small push.[/i]

[b]Workshop experience cost increased:[/b] [i]The Workshop was too easy to level up compared to all the other farms. Therefore it has been made more expensive but gives also much more income to compensate for the cost. We understand that other Material sources should be available in the game.[/i]

[b]Reduced offline earnings:[/b] [i]The amount of currency achieved offline was too high which didn't encourage players to play the game. The amount of currency you get while being offline has been reduced but might need to be rebalanced again.[/i]

[b]Golden profit items buffed:[/b] [i]The golden items that the player buys from the coin shop for each farm felt pointless because they didn't give a fair amount of coins. They have been buffed by 2.5.[/i]

[b]Extended loot radius for every collectable item:[/b] [i]Sometimes it felt like you were missing the item, even though you were clicking on it. We increased the looting radius for all collectable items to make them easier to loot. It's not always fun to click the Egg right in the center.[/i]

[b]The frequency of mails reduced:[/b] [i]The mails popped up too often and the frequency of them has been reduced.[/i]

[b]Lowering music volume when achievement sound plays:[/b] [i]It always felt a bit of a chaos when both the music and the achievement music were playing on top of each other. Therefore it was best to reduce the music by 50% while the achievement music was playing.[/i]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
Now that all of the bugs are eliminated, we are focusing on adding new features to Farmtale. It is important for us to add more things to do while the player is waiting for more currency to spend on the pirate ship. Therefore we are currently adding features that will introduce both progression and degression.

[b]Pirate Attacks:[/b] Pirates will occasionally discover your farm and attack you!

[b]Tower Defense:[/b] Defend yourself against pirate attacks through mouse clicks. But at some point they get too strong and you're better off with a couple of turrets.

[b]Diamond Currency:[/b] As you've probably already discovered, Farmtale contains diamonds that can be achieved in several ways. They will be displayed right above the Coins counter and you will be able to spend them on awesome things!

[b]Quests:[/b] Complete quests and earn rewards.

[b]Lumberjacks and Scrap Collectors:[/b] Hire a lumberjack to cut down trees and Scrap collectors to pick up metal. It is always our priority to make "clicking" stronger than idling. Therefore you will still make faster progress through manual clicks.

[b]Night Workers:[/b] When you are offline, your farm is unprotected. You can't keep working all day! Therefore pirates will steal from you while you are offline. Hire Night Workers to protect your offline income.

[b]Fishing:[/b] Throw your fishing pole and see what you catch!

[b]Mini Game:[/b] You will see what it's all about. But we can say that the longer you reach into the mini game, the more you can brag to your friends.

[b]Wood Collector:[/b] Another source that will gain you Material! We think that you shouldn't be limited by only having the Workshop as the Material income source (apart from trees and metal parts). Therefore we are adding a new building.

[h1]We hope to see you around in our Community Hub or Discord Server![/h1]
